title: 第十五章 黑风古林灵草淬骨猎妖踪第十六章 幽潭秘药兽啸震天破桎梏
lines: 夜色沉沉，墨色天幕低垂，遮蔽了整片大地的微光。
离开镇北侯府管辖的市井范围，前路再无灯火人烟，只剩一望无际的苍茫山野。晚风穿林而过，裹挟着草木湿气与淡淡的荒兽腥气，吹散了巷道厮杀残留的血腥，也吹开了沈砚全新的修行前路。
身后侯府方向，寂静无声，一片安然。
无人知晓，短短半个时辰之前，府外巷道之内，五名三房精心培养的精锐死士尽数伏诛。无人知晓，那名被全城孤立、资源断绝的旁支少年，已然绝境破境，踏足淬体七重，彻底挣脱了原本的命运枷锁。
柳氏布下的绝杀死局，终究是搬起石头砸了自己的脚，沦为了沈砚破壁晋升的垫脚石。
沈砚步履沉稳，踏在崎岖的山野小径之上，身形隐入浓重的夜色之中。
突破淬体七重之后，他周身气血浑厚绵长，筋骨坚韧数倍，每一步落地都轻盈有力，脚下碎石枯枝无声碎裂，却不发出半分多余响动。历经思过崖罡风淬炼、生死厮杀破壁，他的肉身早已远超普通同阶武者，根基凝练无瑕，没有半点虚浮破绽。
寻常武者仓促突破境界，多半根基不稳、气血虚浮，需要静心调息、丹药稳境。可沈砚的七重境界，是在极致生死压力、极限肉身压榨中硬生生冲破桎梏而来，每一分修为都扎根肉身、沉淀骨髓，凝练程度远超同阶，无需任何滋养稳固，便可随心掌控、战力全开。
一路前行，夜色渐深，山林轮廓愈发清晰。
十里路程，转瞬即至。
前方黑风古林连绵起伏、一望无际，参天古木遮天蔽日，枝桠交错纵横，彻底遮掩了月色星光，林中幽暗深邃、阴风阵阵，隐隐传来荒兽低吼、枝叶簌簌的异响，透着浓郁的蛮荒凶险气息。
这是青阳城周边最有名的蛮荒野林，因林间常年阴风不息、黑雾弥漫，故而得名黑风林。林中遍布低级妖兽、凶蛮野兽，更有不少淬体修行所需的野生灵草、淬体药材，是低阶武者冒险寻源的绝佳之地，也是无数底层修行者的埋骨之地。
富贵险中求，机缘险中取。
对于资源充沛、师门庇护的嫡系天才而言，此地危机四伏、得不偿失；可对于如今被彻底封锁、孤立无援的沈砚来说，这片凶险古林，是他唯一的修行沃土、破局机缘。
“侯府断我丹药、封我灵草、绝我前路，那我便入这黑风古林，以妖兽精血养气血，以天地灵草淬筋骨。”
沈砚驻足林前，抬眼望向幽暗深邃的古林，眸底无半分畏惧，只剩沉稳笃定。
比起人心险恶、阴谋诡谲的镇北侯府，这片直面厮杀、生死分明的蛮荒山林，反倒更加纯粹坦荡。
这里没有阴毒算计、没有温水煮蛙的绝杀布局，只有弱肉强食、适者生存的天地至理。
而这，恰恰是沈砚最擅长的战场。
他不再迟疑，身形一晃，施展流云碎月步，身形如青影掠入黑风古林之中，瞬间被沉沉幽暗吞没。
一入古林，气温骤降，阴冷阴风扑面而来，裹挟着草木腐臭与妖兽腥臊的混杂气息，刺鼻浓烈。林中视野受阻，古木参天、荆棘丛生，地面遍布腐叶湿泥，行走其间步步凶险，稍有不慎便可能触发陷阱、惊扰妖兽。
沈砚敛息凝神，周身气息尽数内敛，脚步轻缓无声，双目在幽暗环境中依旧澄澈锐利，细细扫视周遭一切动静。
突破淬体七重后，他的五感远超从前，视力、听力、感知力全方位暴涨，方圆数十丈内的风吹草动、生灵气息，尽数清晰落入感知之中，任何潜藏的凶险都无处遁形。
沙沙——
林间夜风拂动枝叶，发出细碎声响，混杂着远处隐约的兽吼，让整片山林更显阴森诡异。
沈砚不急不躁，缓步深入，目光精准扫过林间地面的杂草花丛、沟壑石缝。他年少蛰伏之时，曾翻阅侯府典藏的草木图谱、妖兽纪要，对青阳城周边的野生灵草、低级妖兽习性了然于心。
无需丹药滋养，野生灵草便是最贴合肉身的天然淬体资源；无需刻意苦修，猎杀妖兽、生死搏杀，便是最快的打磨手段。
前行百余丈，一缕淡淡的清苦药香悄然钻入鼻尖。
沈砚眸光微亮，脚步一顿，目光锁定左侧树根角落。
只见苍老的树根缝隙之间，几株寸许高的翠绿小草破土而出，叶片圆润、根茎莹白，叶脉间隐隐萦绕着淡淡的灵气微光，正是最基础的淬体灵草——凝骨草。
凝骨草，低级灵草，药性温和、无烈毒，最适合淬体境武者炼化吸收，长期服用可紧实筋骨、剔除肉身杂质、浑厚气血底蕴，是寻常武者最易得、最实用的修行资源。
若是在往日，侯府库房堆积如山，这般低级灵草根本不入嫡系子弟眼界，随手便可取用。可如今，这几株普通的凝骨草，便是沈砚打破资源封锁的第一份机缘。
他缓步上前，指尖轻柔探出，小心翼翼将几株凝骨草连根完整采摘，避免损伤根茎药性。
入手微凉，灵气温润，纯粹的草木药力扑面而来。
沈砚没有立刻炼化，将凝骨草妥善收好，继续纵深前行。
几株凝骨草只能聊胜于无，想要稳固七重境界、打磨极致肉身，还需要更多灵草、更强的妖兽精血淬炼。
越是深入黑风古林，林间的妖兽气息便愈发浓郁，地面随处可见妖兽爪印、脱落的兽毛、残留的骸骨，凶险程度层层递增。
普通武者只敢在外围区域摸索寻宝，不敢深入中层腹地，生怕遭遇高阶妖兽、葬身兽口。但沈砚此刻战力滔天，心境沉稳，无惧周遭凶险，一路稳步纵深，搜寻机缘。
片刻之后，低沉的兽吼骤然在身侧响起！
嗡！
一股野蛮凶悍的腥风扑面而来，地面腐叶骤然翻飞，一道灰黑色的庞大身影猛地从右侧灌木丛中暴冲而出，直扑沈砚腰身，獠牙外露、利爪寒光闪闪，攻势凶悍狂暴！
content_en:
The night was dark, and the dark sky hung low, blocking the glimmer of light from the entire land.
Leaving the market area under the jurisdiction of Zhenbei Hou Mansion, there are no lights or people on the road ahead, only endless mountains and fields. The evening wind passed through the forest, carrying the moisture of the vegetation and the faint smell of wild beasts, blowing away the bloody remains of the fighting in the alley, and also opened up a new path for Shen Yan to practice.
Behind him, in the direction of the Hou Mansion, there was silence and peace.
No one knew that just half an hour ago, in the alley outside the house, five elite dead soldiers carefully trained by the third room were all executed. No one knew that the young man from the side branch who had been isolated by the whole city and cut off from resources had reached a desperate situation and stepped into the seventh level of body tempering, completely breaking free from the shackles of his original destiny.
The killing blow arranged by Liu ended up shooting himself in the foot and became a stepping stone for Shen Yan to break through and advance.
Shen Yan walked steadily on the rugged mountain trails, his figure disappearing into the thick night.
After breaking through the seventh level of body tempering, the energy and blood all over his body were thick and long, and his muscles and bones were several times tougher. Every step he took to the ground was light and powerful. The gravel and dead branches under his feet shattered silently without making any unnecessary noise. After being tempered by the strong winds of the cliffs and breaking through walls in life-and-death battles, his physical body has long been far superior to that of ordinary warriors of the same level. His foundation is condensed and flawless, without any flaws.
Ordinary warriors who rush to break through the realm will most likely have unstable foundations and weak Qi and blood. They need meditation to regulate their breath and use elixirs to stabilize their realm. However, Shen Yan's seventh level is achieved by breaking through the shackles of extreme life and death pressure and extreme physical oppression. Every bit of cultivation is rooted in the physical body and accumulates in the bone marrow. The level of condensation is far beyond that of the same level. No need for any nourishment and stabilization is needed to control it at will and fully unleash its combat power.
As we walked along, the night got darker and the outline of the mountains and forests became clearer.
The ten-mile journey is here in an instant.
Ahead, the Black Wind Ancient Forest stretches as far as the eye can see. The towering ancient trees cover the sky and the sun, and their branches are criss-crossed, completely blocking out the moonlight and starlight. The forest is dark and deep, with gusts of wind, and the faint roars of wild beasts and the rustling of branches and leaves can be heard, giving off a strong wild and dangerous atmosphere.
This is the most famous wild forest around Qingyang City. Because the forest is constantly windy and filled with black mist all year round, it is named Black Wind Forest. The forest is full of low-level monsters and ferocious beasts, as well as many wild spiritual herbs and body-tempering medicinal materials needed for body tempering practice. It is an excellent place for low-level warriors to take risks and find sources, and it is also the burial place for countless low-level practitioners.
Wealth and honor can be found in danger, and opportunities can be obtained in danger.
For the direct geniuses with abundant resources and the protection of their masters, this place is full of dangers and the gains outweigh the losses. But for Shen Yan, who is now completely blocked and isolated, this dangerous ancient forest is his only fertile ground for practice and an opportunity to break the situation.
"The Hou Mansion cuts off my elixirs, seals my spiritual herbs, and cuts off my path forward. Then I will enter the Black Wind Ancient Forest to nourish my energy and blood with the essence and blood of monsters and beasts, and temper my muscles and bones with the spiritual herbs of heaven and earth."
Shen Yan stopped in front of the forest and raised his eyes to look at the dark and deep ancient forest. There was no fear in his eyes, only calmness and determination.
Compared to the sinister and treacherous Zhenbei Hou Mansion, this wild mountain forest, where life and death are clearly defined, is more pure and open.
There is no sinister plot here, no plan to kill the frog by boiling it in warm water, only the law of the jungle and the survival of the fittest.
And this is precisely the battlefield that Shen Yan is best at.
He no longer hesitated, his body swayed, and he used Floating Cloud and Moon Step. His body flew into the black wind ancient forest like a green shadow, and was instantly swallowed up by the deep darkness.
As soon as we entered the ancient forest, the temperature dropped sharply, and the cold wind blew in our face, carrying the mixed smell of rotting vegetation and the fishy smell of monsters and beasts, which was pungent and strong. The view in the forest is blocked, with towering ancient trees and thick thorns. The ground is covered with rotten leaves and wet mud. Every step you walk in is dangerous. A slight mistake may trigger traps and disturb monsters.
Shen Yan held his breath and concentrated, his aura all over his body was restrained, his footsteps were gentle and silent, his eyes were still clear and sharp in the dark environment, and he carefully scanned all the movements around him.
After breaking through the seventh level of body tempering, his five senses were far superior to before. His vision, hearing, and perception increased sharply in all directions. All the movement and breath of life within a radius of dozens of feet were clearly perceived, and any hidden dangers had nowhere to hide.
rustle——
The night wind in the forest stirred the branches and leaves, making a soft sound, mixed with the faint roar of beasts in the distance, making the entire mountain forest even more eerie and strange.
Shen Yan was neither impatient nor impatient, and walked slowly deeper, his eyes accurately scanning the weeds, flowers, ravines and crevices on the forest floor. When he was young and dormant, he read through the vegetation atlas and monster beast records in the Marquis Mansion's collection, and he had a clear understanding of the wild spiritual grass and the habits of low-level monsters around Qingyang City.
There is no need for elixir nourishment, wild spiritual grass is the natural body tempering resource that is most suitable for the body; there is no need for deliberate hard training, hunting monsters and life and death fights is the fastest way to polish one's body.
After walking for more than a hundred feet, a faint scent of bitter medicine quietly penetrated the tip of my nose.
Shen Yan's eyes brightened slightly, his steps paused, and his eyes locked on the corner of the tree root on the left.
Between the gaps between the old tree roots, a few inch-high emerald green grass sprouted from the ground. The leaves were round, the roots were white, and there was a faint light of spiritual energy lingering between the veins. They were the most basic body-tempering spiritual grass - bone-condensing grass.
Bone-condensing grass is a low-grade spiritual grass with mild medicinal properties and no strong poison. It is most suitable for refining and absorption by body-tempering warriors. Long-term use can tighten muscles and bones, remove impurities from the body, and enrich the qi and blood. It is the most accessible and practical cultivation resource for ordinary warriors.
If in the past, the warehouse of the Hou Mansion was piled up like a mountain, such low-level spiritual herbs would not be in the eyes of the direct descendants, and they could be used casually. But now, these ordinary bone-condensing grasses are Shen Yan's first chance to break the resource blockade.
He stepped forward slowly, gently reached out with his fingertips, and carefully picked several Ningguca plants up to their roots to avoid damaging the medicinal properties of the rhizomes.
It's slightly cool in the hand, the spiritual energy is moist, and the pure medicinal power of herbs hits your face.
Shen Yan did not refine it immediately, but kept the bone-condensing grass properly and continued to move forward.
A few bone-condensing grasses are better than nothing. If you want to stabilize the seventh level and polish your body to perfection, you need more spiritual grasses and stronger demonic beast essence and blood tempering.
The deeper you go into the Black Wind Ancient Forest, the stronger the smell of monsters in the forest becomes. Monster claw marks, fallen animal hair, and remaining bones can be seen everywhere on the ground, and the danger level increases layer by layer.
Ordinary warriors only dare to search for treasures in the outer areas and dare not go deep into the middle hinterland for fear of encountering high-level monsters and being buried in the beast's mouth. But at this moment, Shen Yan's fighting power is overwhelming, his mind is calm, and he is not afraid of the dangers around him. He goes steadily and deeper all the way, searching for opportunities.
A moment later, a low beast roar suddenly sounded beside him!
Buzz!
A savage and ferocious wind blew towards his face, and the rotten leaves on the ground suddenly flew away. A huge gray-black figure suddenly rushed out from the bushes on the right and rushed straight towards Shen Yan's waist. His fangs were exposed and his sharp claws were shining with cold light. The attack was fierce and violent!
title_en: Chapter 15: Black Wind Ancient Forest Spiritual Grass Tempering Bone Hunting Demon Traces Chapter 16: The Secret Medicine Beast in the Deep Pond Shakes the Sky and Breaks the Shackles
